tools.name: get_hermes_resale_report
tools.description: Read a fixed monthly research report from BirkinBagStock, including source URL, cutoff, cohort size, method and caveats. Reseller asking prices are not completed sales or a guaranteed valuation.

tools.name: list_hermes_auctions
tools.description: Read indexed auction sales containing Hermès lots, with dates, catalogue source links and recorded lot counts. Coverage is a sample; sale details can change at the auction house.

tools.name: get_hermes_auction_results
tools.description: Read recorded Hermès auction results with original-currency prices, price basis, check dates and auction-house source links. Hammer and premium-inclusive results differ; coverage is a sample.

tools.name: list_birkin_resellers
tools.description: Read reseller names, regions and indexed available-listing counts from BirkinBagStock. Counts reflect scheduled source checks; inclusion is not an endorsement.

tools.name: find_hermes_care_services
tools.description: Read the independent directory of handbag care and accessory providers by country and category. Directory inclusion does not certify quality or authenticity; this tool does not book or pay for services.

tools.name: search_birkin
tools.description: Search the indexed Birkin catalogue by specifications and USD asking-price budget. Returns at most 10 listing pages with seller names. Data reflects scheduled source checks, not guaranteed availability; BirkinBagStock does not authenticate bags.

tools.name: get_market_price
tools.description: Calculate USD asking-price statistics for matching indexed Birkin listings. Includes sample and priced-listing counts when available. These are seller offers, not completed sales, authentication or a guaranteed appraisal.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Compare the recorded specifications and USD asking prices of two or three distinct listing IDs. Price-on-request listings may have no numeric price; the lowest recorded ask is not a quality or authenticity recommendation.

tools.name: get_price_trend
tools.description: Read daily indexed median-ask snapshots for an existing Birkin specification over 7–90 days. May return insufficient_data or no_landing. Changing samples affect trends; historical asks do not predict returns or future prices.

tools.name: list_market_movers
tools.description: Read specifications with the largest recorded median-ask percentage changes over 2–30 days in the indexed snapshot history. Limited or changing samples may yield insufficient_data; changes are not investment forecasts.

tools.name: list_popular_specs
tools.description: Read frequently requested specification pages with recorded match counts. Popularity reflects BirkinBagStock page requests, not market-wide sales or demand. Returns at most 12 specification pages.

tools.name: get_authentication_signals
tools.description: Read a curated inspection checklist, recorded blind-stamp year references and leather notes. Educational reference only: no photographs are analyzed and no individual bag is certified authentic or counterfeit.
